ValidationRule.description: [INC0174261] "Purchasing Model" field on the Partner Inquiry Object. Only the Tanium Partner Portal Admin Profile should be able to save a record with "Single Transactor" selected in the "Purchasing Model" field. Both the "Tanium CAM" and "Tanium Standard
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
ISCHANGED(Sales_Model__c) &&
ISPICKVAL(Sales_Model__c,"Single Transactor")&&
NOT($Profile.Name="API Only Integration Admin") && NOT($Profile.Name="System Administrator") && NOT($Profile.Name="Tanium System Administrator") && NOT($Profile.Name="Tanium Partner Portal Admin")

ISPICKVAL(Sales_Model__c,"Single Transactor")&&
NOT($Profile.Name="API Only Integration Admin") && NOT($Profile.Name="System Administrator") && NOT($Profile.Name="Tanium Partner Portal Admin")*/
